hero_title: Converse with God, Hear His Grace
hero_subtitle: Find peace in your busy life, let daily devotion nourish your spirit and illuminate your day.
daily_devotion_desc: Receive inspiring devotional content tailored for morning and evening, deepen your connection with God through personalized prayers, starting your day with a smile and ending in peace.
bible_quiz_desc: Test your knowledge and deepen understanding through engaging questions. Interact with the Bible in a fun and meaningful way from Genesis to Revelation.
multi_version_desc: Support for NLT, KJV, NIV, Chinese Union Version and more, with built-in original language dictionaries to meet needs from new believers to theological researchers.
community_desc: Connect with thousands of believers, share scripture cards with one click, spread faith and encourage others.
audio_bible_desc: Support for Mandarin, Cantonese, English and other languages, download and listen to God's word anytime without internet connection.
reading_plan_desc: Systematic five-year reading plan or custom progress, with progress tracking to help you build a stable devotional habit.
notes_desc: Record insights while reading, sync across multiple devices via cloud, collect impactful devotional content for repeated reflection.
review_1: "This app has completely transformed my morning routine. I used to check social media first thing when I woke up, now I open Grace Word and receive daily spiritual nourishment. The tailored content for morning and evening is so thoughtful."
review_2: "The Bible quiz feature has helped me memorize and understand scriptures more deeply. I also share scripture cards on my social media, and many friends have started reading the Bible because of these cards."
review_3: "As a seminary student, the original text analysis and multi-version comparison features are extremely helpful; while my mother only uses it to listen to the audio Bible, which is simple to operate. This is truly an app for everyone."
quiz_description: Through a fun test, discover which Bible character you resemble most and explore your spiritual traits.
faq_1_question: Is the Grace Word app free?
faq_1_answer: The basic features of Grace Word (including multi-version reading, daily devotionals, and audio Bible) are completely free. Some in-depth commentaries, special articles, and advanced original text analysis features are available through in-app purchases to support content creators and the platform's continued development.
faq_2_answer: We currently support 42 versions including Chinese Union Version (CUV), New Punctuation CUV, Revised CUV, NIV, KJV, NLT, and more, with continuous additions. All content has obtained proper copyright authorization.
faq_3_question: How do I sync my notes and highlights across different devices?
faq_3_answer: Simply register for a free Grace Word account within the app, and your devotional notes, highlighted passages, and reading progress will automatically sync through the cloud. We also support backing up data to Dropbox to ensure your spiritual records are safe and secure.
faq_4_question: Can I use Grace Word without internet?
faq_4_answer: Yes. You can pre-download Bible texts and audio Bible when connected to WiFi, and then read, listen, and take notes smoothly even in subway, airplane, or other environments without internet connection.
download_description: Download Grace Word and let God's word be your guide and strength every day.
